_comment: Staging integration policy (FACTORY.md §6a). Copy to .github/factory-branches.json. This is the ORG's policy, identical across the estate: every implementation PR the factory opens is based on the integration branch named here, and nothing reaches the default branch except a promotion PR from it. `staging` is that branch's name — call it staging, develop, qa, integration, whatever the org uses; the name is arbitrary, the step is not. `required: true` (the default) means an implementation PR may never be based on the default branch: a repo that has no integration branch gets one. `auto_create: true` lets the Release Manager cut the branch from the default branch the first time it is needed, so adopting the policy costs no manual setup. A repo whose branch is genuinely called something else overrides the NAME (only the name) in its .factory/profile.json `branches.staging`. Set `required: false` to opt an estate out and fall back to the pre-policy behaviour: staging where a profile names one, the default branch everywhere else.
